source.name: Yamaha Motor: Prima Pramac Yamaha MotoGP Unveils Its 2026 Project in Siena
source.quote: Prima Assicurazioni will once again be the title sponsor of Prima Pramac Yamaha MotoGP for the 2026 season

source.name: Alpine media: Alpine becomes the new main partner of Prima Pramac Yamaha MotoGP for the MotoGP 2025 season
source.quote: Alpine becomes the main partner of the Prima Pramac Yamaha MotoGP team
source.note: Announced for the 2025 season as a long-term partnership; Alpine is still listed as a Main Partner on the team's official partners page (pramacracing.com/en/partners-en/, logo grid), checked 2026-10-03.

source.name: RTR Sports Marketing: 21.com secures Prima Pramac Yamaha MotoGP sponsorship
source.quote: 21.com partnered with Pramac Racing Yamaha in the MotoGP world championship
source.note: Case study by the sponsorship agency that brokered the deal (no date on the page). It says 21.com's brand goes on the side fairings of the YZR-M1, the riders' caps and racing suits. 21.com is also listed as a Main Partner on the team's partners page (checked 2026-10-03).

source.name: FIAMM press release: FIAMM al fianco di Prima Pramac Yamaha MotoGP per il triennio 2026-2028
source.quote: Prima Pramac Yamaha è lieta di annunciare il rinnovo della collaborazione con FIAMM per il triennio 2026–2028
source.note: Translation: Prima Pramac Yamaha announces the renewal of the partnership with FIAMM for 2026-2028; the release adds FIAMM's logo goes on the bikes' windscreens.

source.name: Corpay newsroom: Corpay Cross-Border Named the Official Commercial FX Partner of Prima Pramac Racing
source.quote: Under the agreement, Corpay becomes Pramac Racing's Official Commercial Foreign Exchange (FX) Partner and a Premium Partner of the team

source.name: Finance Magnates: Racing, but Not F1: CFD Broker ACCM to Promote Brand as a MotoGP Team Sponsor
source.quote: it has become a multi-year sponsor of the Prima Pramac Yamaha MotoGP team
source.note: Named press; the broker is the team's Official Partner.

summary: Title sponsor Prima Assicurazioni on the front (Yamaha's 2026 launch release); Alpine, 21.com, FIAMM, Corpay and ACCM are sourced team partners. Not complete: the team's partners page (pramacracing.com) names further partners by logo only, without matching text a script can quote — Motul, AON, Synergie, Sunenergy, Quint, Dainese, Michelin, Akrapovic, Beta, WRS, Accossato, RCB, Kappa, Cetilar, RDS, Baladin, Cecchi and Cirfood — plus title partner Pramac (the team's own company, in the Generac group since 2016) and manufacturer partner Yamaha, which aren't added as shirt sponsors.
